description.narrative: THE OBJECTIVE OF THE PROJECT IS TO PROVIDE AN EFFICIENT AND SUSTAINABLE ARRANGEMENT FOR THE PROVISION OF POTABLE WATER AND SEWERAGE SERVICES. THE PROJECT COMPRISES A COMPONENT OF INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING AND TRAINING AS WELL AS THE CONSTRUCTION OF A SEWERAGE SYSTEM FOR THE CITY INCLUDING A COLLECTION NETWORK, PUMPING STATIONS AND A TREATMENT PLANT.
